# `fluxsim plan`

Execute the whole pipeline once, in memory, and write down what it saw: inputDigest, the seed-tree paths it materialised, the per-emit seam digests, and each declared fidelity block as it compiled, every epsilon included. Writes plan.json and seed-paths.ndjson under the run directory.

## Synopsis

```text
fluxsim plan [options] <bundle>
```

## Examples

```bash
# record what a run would do
fluxsim plan ./bundle

# keep the run state somewhere else
fluxsim plan ./bundle --state-dir ./.flux

# plan the run under kernel 0.2.0
fluxsim plan ./bundle --kernel 0.2.0
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `bundle` | path to the FLUX bundle directory |

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--simulation-id` | `SIMULATION_ID` | which Simulation document to resolve (default: the bundle's only one) |
| `--zone` | `ZONE` | declared run zone, for sovereignty checks |
| `--kernel` | `VERSION` | the kernel the new plan takes, one of 0.1.0, 0.2.0 (default 0.1.0). The plan records it, and apply, replay, verify and ship run the kernel their plan names; 0.2.0's streams are counter-based and its continuous draws binary64 (docs/spec/KERNEL-SPEC-2.md), so its digests differ from 0.1.0's |
| `--jobs` | `N` | the most processes that may generate the rows of an emit declared by statistics: a number (never more than one per CPU) or auto for one per CPU; the run summary says how many it used, and the rows and every digest are the same whatever the number (default: FLUX_JOBS, else 1) |
| `--strict-coverage` |  | refuse the run when a column falls back to a type default (an optional column nothing maps onto, a DATE or TIMESTAMP column with no declaration of its own), with a table of every such column, before any row is drawn; a Simulation can ask for the same with strictCoverage: true in its extensions; without either the plan names those columns and goes on, and with this flag the rows and every digest are the same either way |
| `--profile` | `PATH` | the profile document the Simulation pins under extensions['com.agentics.flux/1'].profile (docs/spec/PROFILE-SPEC.md); refused when its digest is not the pinned one, and when the Simulation pins none |
| `--state-dir` | `STATE_DIR` | run-state directory (default: ./.flux) |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
